_note: Injury-aware game odds (v1.8.0). Validated 2026-11-16 on 8 seasons (calibration/experiments/injury_backtest.py, injury_powerrank.py): knowing who is out before a game and handing his minutes to his replacement improved single-game predictions (log-loss) 0.23% overall, 0.73% when a team was missing 0.1+ goals/game of talent, 2.2% when missing 0.2+; the lost talent's weight equals any other lineup change (fitted 1.11 vs 0.98, overlapping). For rest-of-season power ratings it made no difference (within 0.1% at 14-60 games; out=gone was worse midseason), so power rankings are unchanged; the season simulation applies the adjustment game by game, only while the player is expected to be out. surv[k] = share of absence spells (a regular missing consecutive games, 16,448 spells) that lasted at least k games: P(still out for one more game | out k so far) = surv[k+1]/surv[k].

status_rules.Day-To-Day: out only if he missed the team's latest game; then by surv
status_rules.Out: out next game; then by surv
status_rules.Injured Reserve: out next game; then by surv (7-day minimum)
status_rules.IR-LT: out at least 10 games from placement; then by surv
